description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) demonstrating how to load, manipulate, and visualize historical financial data using the OpenBB Platform. It includes code examples for fetching data from various providers, resampling time series, and handling different asset types.

classes.name: HistoricalPrices
classes.description: A class encapsulating various time intervals of historical market data for a given symbol, loaded via the OpenBB Platform.

methods.name: load_historical
methods.description: Function to initialize and return a HistoricalPrices object with loaded time series data for a specified symbol, start and end dates, and data provider.
